requirements.requirement: Save link / clipboard / new editor / normalized duplicates
requirements.assertions: Browser checks for actual copied-link row and new bookmark editor use production scoped capture, metadata HTTP and SQLite. Rust tests reject stale scope/read-only/invalid IDs and freeze retries. Native smoke repeats real Tauri IPC and cookie-free loopback GET. URL-only shortcut policy is tested without reading the real clipboard/selection or registering global keys.

Owned HTTP fixture asserts OG title precedence, fallback title/host, five redirects, 512KB limit, five-second timeout, no Cookie/Authorization on redirected requests and no extra GET when downloader metadata is already authoritative. UTF16 titles are capped at 300.

requirements.requirement: All five browsers / exact source allowlist
requirements.assertions: Synthetic Chrome, Edge, Brave and Vivaldi roots contain real Local State and Bookmarks plus forbidden History/Cookies/Login Data decoys. Firefox stays open in WAL mode while the real importer reads a private readonly copy and queries only bookmark rows. Browser import sheet displays exact read paths and HTML fixture picker adds one selected export. Reader refuses non-allowlisted files before opening.

requirements.requirement: Tack HTML parity / dates / folder labels
requirements.assertions: Pinned immutable Tack bookmarks.ts executes in the browser through its real DOMParser walk, with only the card constructor stubbed. Native HTML5 output matches URL/title/labels/ADD_DATE; Nabbit drops browser-root labels. JSON1601 microseconds, Firefox1970 microseconds and HTMLseconds produce the same dated cards; unsupported URLs are skipped before metadata validation.

requirements.requirement: Import options / duplicate counts / batching / grouped undo
requirements.assertions: UI defaults to Later, folders-as-labels and duplicate skipping. Unit tests also cover Inbox/disabled-labels/duplicates-off and atomic rollback. 56 cards cross real sync as 50+6; one idempotent import receipt and undo group survive restart, retry and explicit local-to-Tack upload remapping. Undo preserves edits made after import.

requirements.requirement: Tray / island Links / bulk / video route
requirements.assertions: Search matches title/domain and combines Later/labels. Selection freezes scope/content guards; Label/Later/Archive are atomic and stale/read-only writes preserve selection. Open-all validates selected URLs and Copy preserves original URLs; automation records these side effects. Video Download stages review. Shared island Links remains dark and lazy; new-note drop saves bookmark while the separate download zone stages media review.

Ten final states across light/dark and1x/1.5x retain exact repeats, default axe with zero violations/incompletes, original SVG hashes/sizes and bundled Geist. Independent Pillow audit covers every retained M9 PNG at <=300000 bytes. Initial island graph remains below120000 gzip bytes and excludes app store/editor/settings. No new sidecars; dom_query was already locked transitively and is now an exact direct dependency.

limits.nativePicker: Compiled Windows IFileOpenDialog, tested through an injected picker; never opens a user browser export or real browser profile during acceptance.
limits.selection: Windows UI Automation adapter compiled; policy/source providers tested. No real selection, clipboard, global shortcut or synthetic Ctrl+C is invoked.
limits.platforms: Automated acceptance on this Windows machine only; no macOS/Linux runtime or external DPI/display claim.
limits.backlog: Dead-link and duplicate review/export remain v2.1; general selected-text tools remain V5.17.
